ActivityBucket.description:
What agents called: a tool or a category of call, how many times, and
the call time summed over them (so parallel calls add up past the wall
time).
ActivityBucket.title: ActivityBucket

ActivityHour.description:
The agent turns that started in one hour (UTC): their wall time in the
parts that add up to it, and what they called. The viewer's time zone makes
days of these.
ActivityHour.title: ActivityHour

Age.description:
A duration for display. ``since`` (ISO time) is set while it is still
growing, so the page can keep the text current; ``None`` once it ended.
Age.title: Age

AgentConversation.description: What a run has said and done so far.
AgentConversation.title: AgentConversation

AgentDecision.description:
What the dispatcher concluded about one task whose next action is
something an agent does. A reason of ``working`` means an agent is on it.
AgentDecision.title: AgentDecision

AgentMessage.description: One step of a run's conversation.
AgentMessage.title: AgentMessage

AgentReason.description: Why an agent is not (or not yet) on a task, or on any task.
AgentReason.title: AgentReason

AgentSpend.description: What agents have spent, against the global limits.
AgentSpend.title: AgentSpend

AgentStart.description: The body of ``POST /api/agents/start``: start a run by hand.
AgentStart.title: AgentStart

AgentsEvent.description: The autonomous agents' state changed (what the Agents view shows).
AgentsEvent.title: AgentsEvent

AggregateActivity.description:
What agents did in their turns (see ``agent_activity``), recorded by the
Claude Code plugin: only hours with a turn are listed.
AggregateActivity.title: AggregateActivity

AggregateLane.description:
A lane's layer of the aggregate view: how often its spans were on the
tasks in flight, and its markers (see ``timeline_lanes.py``).
AggregateLane.title: AggregateLane

AggregateLaneEvents.description: When (in the window) markers of this kind happened, on the tasks.
AggregateLaneEvents.title: AggregateLaneEvents

AggregateLanePhase.description:
The share of the tasks in flight (at each of ``mix.starts``) that had
a span of this kind of lane ``lane`` then, and how many.
AggregateLanePhase.title: AggregateLanePhase

AggregateSamples.description:
The instants every series of the aggregate view is sampled at: a
snapshot of the tasks in flight at each (not an average over time).
AggregateSamples.title: AggregateSamples

AutonomousSpend.description:
What autonomous agent runs cost: exactly, from each run's own record
(not estimated from transcripts like the interactive figures).
AutonomousSpend.title: AutonomousSpend

BranchExtras.description: The parts of a task card that do not come with its PR status.
BranchExtras.title: BranchExtras

CardAgent.description: What a task card says about the autonomous agents on one branch.
CardAgent.title: CardAgent

CardEstimate.description:
When a task is estimated to be finished (merged): a median and a p80
as UTC instants, or unknown. Working-time arithmetic is the server's (the
working hours are in its config); the client formats the instants.
CardEstimate.title: CardEstimate

CardSpend.description: What a task has cost, over all the spend on record.
CardSpend.title: CardSpend

CardValidation.description:
Where a task stands on "validate, personal review, publish"
(``docs/personal-review.md``).
CardValidation.title: CardValidation

ChipGroups.description: The label of each "now" chip group.
ChipGroups.title: ChipGroups

ClaimHolder.description:
A live holder of a claim on a branch (see ``task_claims``). Only live
holders are sent: an expired one is gone.
ClaimHolder.title: ClaimHolder

ClaimsEvent.description:
Claims changed on some branches. Lists those and the branches stacked
on them (their next action follows the parent's).
ClaimsEvent.title: ClaimsEvent

ConflictInfo.description: The commit a branch's conflict comes from.
ConflictInfo.title: ConflictInfo

ConversationEvent.description: A run that is working said or did something: its conversation so far.
ConversationEvent.title: ConversationEvent

DecisionAnswerRequest.description:
The body of ``POST /api/decisions/answer``: one answer per point, each an
option, words, or both.
DecisionAnswerRequest.title: DecisionAnswerRequest

DecisionInfo.description: A question an agent asked about a task, and the user's answer once given.
DecisionInfo.title: DecisionInfo

DecisionList.description: The decisions about one branch's task, oldest first.
DecisionList.title: DecisionList

EstimateAblation.description:
The pinball-loss change when a feature is taken out of ``model``
(positive: worse without it, so signal; near zero or negative: noise).
EstimateAblation.title: EstimateAblation

EstimateAccuracy.description:
The finish estimate's track record: the stored backtests, oldest
first, and the shown estimates compared with the actual finishes.
EstimateAccuracy.title: EstimateAccuracy

EstimateBreakdown.description: What the card's popup shows for one task.
EstimateBreakdown.title: EstimateBreakdown

EstimateChampion.description:
The model that answers for a stage and why: ``margin`` is its loss
advantage over the baseline (0: the baseline stays).
EstimateChampion.title: EstimateChampion

EstimateFactor.description: A group the baseline scaled the estimate by.
EstimateFactor.title: EstimateFactor

EstimateRegime.description: A stage whose median duration moved between two windows.
EstimateRegime.title: EstimateRegime

EstimateStageAccuracy.description: How a backtest's predictions fared for one stage (``all`` for every).
EstimateStageAccuracy.title: EstimateStageAccuracy

ExtrasEvent.description: What the task cards show beyond their PR status changed.
ExtrasEvent.title: ExtrasEvent

FailedStatus.description: The lookup was attempted and failed.
FailedStatus.title: FailedStatus

HelloEvent.description:
Sent on connect: the current version (a client that last saw another
one missed something) and how stale the cache is.
HelloEvent.title: HelloEvent

HolderActivity.description:
What a claim's holder is running: the tool call in flight (``open``),
else the last that ended.
HolderActivity.title: HolderActivity

Link.description: ``href`` is ``None`` when the value cannot (or should not) be linked.
Link.title: Link

LoadingStatus.description: No result in yet (or the repo's checkout is missing: nothing to ask).
LoadingStatus.title: LoadingStatus

MergeQueueInfo.description:
Where a branch's PR stands in the merge queue (``None`` on a branch when
there is nothing to say: not queued, nothing that can be queued, no note).
MergeQueueInfo.title: MergeQueueInfo

MergeRequest.description: The body of ``POST /api/merge``: land the branch's PR.
MergeRequest.title: MergeRequest

ModelAccuracy.description:
A model's recent record: on the latest backtest's points for the stage
(``all``: every stage), and when it was last fitted.
ModelAccuracy.title: ModelAccuracy

ModelForecast.description:
One model's answer for a task: the finish as UTC instants (``None``:
it has no answer), its explanation, and what it learned that matters here
(``details``: the baseline's factors and level, the regression's biggest
contributions, the hazard's shape and coefficients, the trees'
importances).
ModelForecast.title: ModelForecast

ModelMetrics.description: One model's metrics on a backtest.
ModelMetrics.title: ModelMetrics

ParentWait.description:
The wait for the parent a stacked task is blocked on: the parent's own
finish, and the combined finish (the later of the two, plus what usually
follows a parent landing).
ParentWait.title: ParentWait

PathStage.description:
A stage that typically follows, from the reference class: the share of
similar tasks that went through it and its working time per task.
PathStage.title: PathStage

PersonalReviewState.description:
What the Review view needs to know of the branch it shows, when it is a
tracked branch with no PR that a validate run has reviewed.
PersonalReviewState.title: PersonalReviewState

PrMilestones.description:
One PR of the user's and the UTC instants its lead times are measured
between. The server does no calendar arithmetic (day, week and weekend
are the viewer's time zone's): the client buckets and subtracts.
PrMilestones.title: PrMilestones

RefreshedEvent.description:
A polling pass finished: the branches it looked up (changed or not)
and when, which their cards say they are as old as.
RefreshedEvent.title: RefreshedEvent

RepoWebhook.description:
A repo the user administers whose GitHub webhook is not working (the
repo is then only polled).
RepoWebhook.title: RepoWebhook

ReviewVerdictInfo.description: The user's review of a branch before its PR (``review_verdicts``).
ReviewVerdictInfo.title: ReviewVerdictInfo

SiblingConflict.description: Another open task whose branch does not merge cleanly with this one's.
SiblingConflict.title: SiblingConflict

SiblingConflictsInfo.description:
How a branch's head merges with the other open tasks' of its repo (see
``sibling_conflicts``). ``None`` on a branch when there is nothing to say.
SiblingConflictsInfo.title: SiblingConflictsInfo

SimilarTask.description: A past stage like this one (the reference class).
SimilarTask.title: SimilarTask

SlackAccepted.description:
The answer to ``POST /api/slack/send``: the message is being posted in
the background. Its PRs read ``posting`` until it is done; then they read
posted, or carry a ``notice`` saying why not.
SlackAccepted.title: SlackAccepted

SlackDraft.description:
A message waiting for the user to confirm. The text shows a person as
``@name``; it becomes a real Slack mention when sent.
SlackDraft.title: SlackDraft

SlackDraftRequest.description:
The body of ``POST /api/slack/draft``: the message to post or bump the
branch's PR, as toolbelt would write it.
SlackDraftRequest.title: SlackDraftRequest

SlackInfo.description:
Where a branch's PR stands in Slack, from the posts toolbelt recorded
(``None`` on a branch when Slack is not configured or it has no PR).
SlackInfo.title: SlackInfo

SlackPerson.description: Someone who can be asked to review: Slack display name and user ID.
SlackPerson.title: SlackPerson

SlackPrRef.description: A PR named in a Slack message: ``repo`` is ``owner/name``, lower case.
SlackPrRef.title: SlackPrRef

SlackSendRequest.description:
The body of ``POST /api/slack/send``: post the confirmed (possibly
edited) message and record it.
SlackSendRequest.title: SlackSendRequest

SlackSpend.description:
What the sessions that read or posted in Slack for toolbelt cost:
exactly, from each session's own report. Not in the interactive figures.
SlackSpend.title: SlackSpend

SpendBucket.description: What one stretch of time cost.
SpendBucket.title: SpendBucket

SpendEvent.description:
The spend ledger was read again: the Spend view's data for each of its
windows (a one-, seven- and thirty-day breakdown).
SpendEvent.title: SpendEvent

SpendTask.description:
Spend attributed to one task through claims. ``task_id`` is ``None``
for the spend no claim covers; ``repo`` and ``branch`` are ``None`` there
and for a task that is no longer known. A call two tasks' claims cover at
once is split evenly, so the figures are fractional.
SpendTask.title: SpendTask

SpendTokens.description: Tokens by kind; ``input`` is the uncached input.
SpendTokens.title: SpendTokens

StatusEvent.description:
A branch's status changed (also sent for every branch stacked on it:
its next action depends on this one's PR).
StatusEvent.title: StatusEvent

StructureEvent.description: The stack DB was written: the client re-fetches the snapshot.
StructureEvent.title: StructureEvent

TimelineEvent.description:
One event of a PR's history, in time order. ``ci`` is, for a commit
(or the commit a force push replaced), its CI result (``""``: none).
TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent

TimelineLane.description:
One lane of a card's timeline, under the PR track (see
``timeline_lanes.py``): what that source recorded for the branch.
TimelineLane.title: TimelineLane

UntrackedEvent.description: The list of open PRs that toolbelt does not track changed.
UntrackedEvent.title: UntrackedEvent

UntrackedPr.description:
An open PR of the user's that is not a tracked branch: shown as a
link only (``repo`` is ``owner/name``).
UntrackedPr.title: UntrackedPr

WaitingOn.description:
The tasks in flight that are waiting on this one, at each sampled
instant: the "next" lane's phases grouped by who the next action waits
on.
WaitingOn.title: WaitingOn

WebhooksEvent.description: Which administered repos have a webhook that is not working changed.
WebhooksEvent.title: WebhooksEvent

WouldBeAction.description: What a claimed branch's next action would be without the claim.
WouldBeAction.title: WouldBeAction

description:
The schema root: lists everything the client reads (never
instantiated).
title: Wire
